profile.belief: I’m a former college athlete.  After I suffered 3 significant injuries in a row, I decided to take some film classes at my local junior college while I recovered.  It was there that I found out the similarities between sports and film.  People working together towards a common goal to create something meaningful.  The better the teamwork and community, the better the product.  I think this industry is so important in understanding other perspectives, while also giving people all over the world something to enjoy and talk about with one another.  Who wouldn’t want to be a part of that?
profile.working_on: I want to do what Rachel Sennott, Quinta Brunson, and Issa Rae are doing.  A mix of writing, performing, and maybe directing.  However, I am incredibly open to wherever the wind takes me.
